content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Online travel marketplace earning booking fees; it does not own or lease office buildings to corporate tenants."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Diversified holding company with billboards, broadband and insurance; no office property leasing business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Building systems installation and maintenance services; it services buildings rather than owning and leasing office space."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Same landlord model, but it owns senior housing and medical properties, not office buildings."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Out-of-home advertising displays sold to brands; no office property ownership or leasing."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants on long-term leases, matching the target's business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Consumer lease-to-own payment plans for merchandise; not commercial property leasing."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Same landlord model, but it owns retail shopping centers leased to retailers, not office buildings."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Manages REITs for a fee rather than owning and leasing its own office buildings to tenants."}]}
